title.zh: 已发表的汇总统计：暂时拿不到原始数据时可以先用的对照数
title.en: Published aggregate statistics: comparison numbers usable while the underlying data cannot be obtained

_doc.zh: 每一条都是从开放获取论文的表格里取的汇总数（均值、标准差、帧数），由脚本从 Europe PMC 的全文 XML 里解析，没有手抄。原文留在本机 data/raw/reference/open-access-papers/。这些论文都是 CC BY 4.0，引用其中的数字需要署名（见各条的 source）。DISFA、BP4D、UNBC-McMaster、BIWI、VOCASET、SKEL 的原始数据都要签协议才能拿，这里没有它们的任何原始数据。未经专业人员审校。
_doc.en: Every entry is an aggregate (mean, SD, frame count) taken from a table of an open-access paper, parsed by script from the Europe PMC full-text XML rather than copied by hand. The papers are kept locally under data/raw/reference/open-access-papers/. All of them are CC BY 4.0; numbers quoted from them need attribution (see source in each entry). The raw data of DISFA, BP4D, UNBC-McMaster, BIWI, VOCASET and SKEL are released only under signed agreements and none of it is here. Not reviewed by a specialist.

quantity.zh: UNBC-McMaster 肩痛表情库：各 PSPI 分值的视频帧数
quantity.en: UNBC-McMaster shoulder pain archive: number of video frames at each PSPI score

population.zh: 25 名肩痛患者，200 段视频，共 48,398 帧（数据库作者逐帧给出的 PSPI，0–15）
population.en: 25 patients with shoulder pain, 200 sequences, 48,398 frames (PSPI 0-15 per frame as provided by the database creators)

entries.tableCaption: Frequency distribution of video frames in the UNBC-McMaster and DISFA databases by PSPI scores and PSPI groups.

source.name: Barua PD et al. 2022, Sci Rep 12:17297, Table 5 (frame counts by PSPI score; counts for the UNBC-McMaster and DISFA databases)

corroboration.name: Ye X et al. 2022, Bioengineering 9(12):804, Table 1 (same frame counts; 40,029 frames = 82.7439 % at PSPI 0)

checks.zh: 疼痛表情模型输出的 PSPI（AU4 + max(AU6,AU7) + max(AU9,AU10) + AU43）在“真实患者做活动度检查”这种情境下的分布应当极度偏向 0：约 83% 的帧为 0，PSPI ≥ 6 的帧不到 1.5%。可用来检查我们的疼痛等级到面部动作的映射是否过于夸张。这是二手转述的帧数，不是我们从数据库算的。
checks.en: The PSPI (AU4 + max(AU6,AU7) + max(AU9,AU10) + AU43) produced by the pain-expression model, in the setting of real patients doing range-of-motion tests, should be extremely skewed towards 0: about 83 % of frames are 0 and under 1.5 % reach PSPI >= 6. Usable to check whether our mapping from pain level to facial action is exaggerated. These are frame counts quoted from secondary papers, not computed by us from the database.

quantity.zh: DISFA：按 AU 强度标注换算出的 PSPI 各分值帧数（Barua 等人算的）
quantity.en: DISFA: number of frames at each PSPI score derived from the AU intensity codes (computed by Barua et al.)

population.zh: 27 名成年人看情绪诱发视频的自发表情，共 130,798 帧
population.en: 27 adults, spontaneous expressions while watching emotion-eliciting video, 130,798 frames

note.zh: 原表有合并单元格，这里保留原始各行的单元格，列的含义见 tableCaption 和原文；DISFA 的列在 UNBC 两列之后。
note.en: The source table has merged cells; the raw cells of each row are kept here, column meanings are in tableCaption and the paper; the DISFA columns follow the two UNBC columns.

entries.tableCaption: Frequency distribution of video frames in the UNBC-McMaster and DISFA databases by PSPI scores and PSPI groups.

source.name: Barua PD et al. 2022, Sci Rep 12:17297, Table 5 (frame counts by PSPI score; counts for the UNBC-McMaster and DISFA databases)

checks.zh: 非疼痛情境（看视频）下与疼痛相关的 AU 组合出现得有多少：可作为我们“无痛时”面部动作基线的对照。
checks.en: How often pain-related AU combinations occur in a non-pain setting (watching video): a contrast for our facial-action baseline without pain.

checks.en: Bone-to-skin distance on the midline: checks the gap between skull and skin meshes of our head model at these landmarks. Note: midline landmarks only, no bilateral points; the sample is orthodontic patients, not a general population.

population.zh: 巴西成年人 101 人（女 56、男 45；18 岁以上），CBCT，坐位
population.en: 101 Brazilian adults (56 female, 45 male; 18 and older), CBCT, seated

entries.tableCaption: Mean FSTT (millimeters and percentage), SD, and SE divided by sex.

source.name: Moritsugui DS et al. 2022, PLoS One 17(7):e0270980

checks.zh: 带左右成对标志点（颧、眶外侧、下颌角、咬合线、臼齿上下等）的按性别厚度表：检查面颊和下颌角处皮肤到骨的间距，以及左右对称性。原表里有两行名字几乎相同（“Ectomolare 2”和“Ectomolare₂”），应是上、下第二磨牙处，使用前请对照原文表 2。
checks.en: A by-sex table with bilateral landmarks (malar, lateral orbit, gonion, occlusal line, supra/infra second molar...): checks skin-to-bone distance at cheek and mandibular angle, and left-right symmetry. Two rows of the source table have almost the same name ("Ectomolare 2" and "Ectomolare₂"), presumably the upper and lower second molar; check against Table 2 of the paper before use.

quantity.en: Facial soft-tissue thickness: 12 midline and 19 bilateral points, adult women

population.zh: 尼日利亚成年女性 32 人，18–95 岁，CT（仰卧）

entries.tableCaption: Mean values of midline FSTT points for the CNFE (mm) / Descriptive data of bilateral FSTT for the CNFE

source.name: Adegbite N et al. 2026, Int J Legal Med, doi 10.1007/s00414-026-03794-1

checks.zh: 女性、带左右点、点位最多的一张表（含咬肌中部、下颌体中部、鼻旁等）。年龄跨度很大、人数少、仰卧位（面颊软组织会后坠），只适合当量级参照。
checks.en: Female, bilateral, and the densest set of points (mid-masseter, mid-mandible, lateral nasal...). Wide age range, small sample and supine posture (cheek tissue sags backwards): a magnitude reference only.

facts.zh: 27 名成年受试者（女 12、男 15）；AU 强度由两名 FACS 专家按 0–5 评分；每帧 66 个面部标志点。
facts.en: 27 adult subjects (12 female, 15 male); AU intensities scored 0-5 by two FACS experts; 66 facial landmarks per image.
BP4D: 41 participants (23 women, 18 men) aged 18-29, 8 emotion tasks each, about 2.6 TB. BP4D+: 140 subjects (82 female, 58 male) aged 18-66, 10 tasks each.

zh: DISFA / BP4D 各 AU 的强度分布和共现矩阵：这次没有在开放论文里找到可机读的表（Walecki 等 2017 的共现只在图里）。
VOCASET / BIWI 的唇、下颌位移幅度和时序：两篇数据集论文这次没有打开；我们的发音器官对照数改用 MOCHA-TIMIT 自己算（见 articulation-summary.json）。
SKEL / BSM 论文里的骨形状常模：这次没有打开论文。
成年女性头部测量（头长、头宽、颧宽、下颌角宽，带标准差）：ANSUR II 公开 CSV 的官方链接当天返回的是网页而不是数据，没有取到。
en: Per-AU intensity distributions and co-occurrence matrices of DISFA / BP4D: no machine-readable table was found in an open paper this time (the co-occurrence in Walecki et al. 2017 is only in a figure).

Lip and jaw displacement amplitudes and timing from VOCASET / BIWI: the two dataset papers were not opened this time; our articulator comparison numbers are computed from MOCHA-TIMIT instead (see articulation-summary.json).
Bone shape norms from the SKEL / BSM papers: the papers were not opened this time.

Adult female head anthropometry (head length, breadth, bizygomatic, bigonial, with SDs): the official links to the ANSUR II public CSVs returned a web page instead of data on the day, so nothing was obtained.

note.zh: 下面这些数据集要签协议才能拿，协议保护被试或禁止转给第三方。本项目没有从任何地方下载它们；需要的话请用户本人按官方流程申请。页面上的联系邮箱这里不抄录。
note.en: The datasets below are released only under a signed agreement that protects participants or forbids passing the data on. This project downloaded none of them from anywhere; the user would apply personally through the official procedure. Contact addresses shown on the pages are not copied here.

procedure.zh: 官方页面：数据库“可为研究目的分发”，通过页面上的 “Submit A Request” 提交申请；DISFA+ 要另签一份协议。协议正文、谁可以申请、多久回复，页面上没有写（这次没有打开协议表单）。
procedure.en: Official page: the database is "available for distribution for research purposes"; a request is submitted through "Submit A Request" on the page, and DISFA+ needs a separate agreement. The agreement text, who may apply and the turnaround are not on the page (the form itself was not opened this time).

procedure.zh: 只提供给非营利研究；学生不能作为接收人（“Students are not eligible to be a recipient. If you are a student, please have your supervisor to make a request.”）；需要接收方与本单位科研管理部门负责人签署书面许可协议；向页面上给出的负责人发邮件申请；商业用途另找该校技术转移办公室。数据量很大（BP4D 约 2.6 TB，BP4D+ 超过 10 TB）。回复时间页面没写。
procedure.en: Non-profit research only; students cannot be recipients ("Students are not eligible to be a recipient. If you are a student, please have your supervisor to make a request."); a written licence agreement signed with the director of the recipient institution's research administration office is required; the request goes by e-mail to the contact named on the page; commercial use goes through the university's technology transfer office. Very large (BP4D about 2.6 TB, BP4D+ over 10 TB). No turnaround stated.

procedure.zh: 官方页面：“Requests must come from a university faculty member or research scientist. Commercial use is not permitted.” 通过页面上的 PainArchive 链接申请。原来的 pitt.edu 页面已是 404。协议表单这次没有打开。
procedure.en: Official page: "Requests must come from a university faculty member or research scientist. Commercial use is not permitted." Requests go through the PainArchive link on that page. The former pitt.edu page is now a 404. The agreement form was not opened this time.

datasets.dataset: BIWI 3D Audiovisual Corpus of Affective Communication (B3D(AC)^2)

procedure.zh: 官方页面当天返回 HTTP 403，没有读到申请流程。凭记忆（未核实）：需要签署协议后发给 ETH 的课题组。
procedure.en: The official page answered HTTP 403 on the day, so the procedure could not be read. From memory (not verified): a signed agreement is sent to the ETH group.

procedure.zh: 在网站注册并登录后下载。许可：“Licensor grants you (Licensee) personally a single-user, non-exclusive, non-transferable, free of charge right” 用于 “non-commercial scientific research, non-commercial education, or non-commercial artistic projects”；“The Data and Software and the license herein granted shall not be copied, shared, distributed, re-sold, offered for re-sale, transferred or sub-licensed in whole or in part except that you may make one copy for archive purposes only.”
procedure.en: Download after registering and signing in on the site. Licence: "Licensor grants you (Licensee) personally a single-user, non-exclusive, non-transferable, free of charge right" for "non-commercial scientific research, non-commercial education, or non-commercial artistic projects"; "The Data and Software and the license herein granted shall not be copied, shared, distributed, re-sold, offered for re-sale, transferred or sub-licensed in whole or in part except that you may make one copy for archive purposes only."

procedure.zh: 在网站注册并登录后下载。许可同为个人、单用户、非商业（科研、教育、艺术）：“Any other use, in particular any use for commercial, pornographic, military, or surveillance, purposes is prohibited.”；“shall not be copied, shared, distributed, re-sold, offered for re-sale, transferred or sub-licensed in whole or in part”（可留一份备份）。
procedure.en: Download after registering and signing in on the site. The licence is likewise personal, single-user and non-commercial (research, education, art): "Any other use, in particular any use for commercial, pornographic, military, or surveillance, purposes is prohibited."; "shall not be copied, shared, distributed, re-sold, offered for re-sale, transferred or sub-licensed in whole or in part" (one backup copy allowed).
